The `comment.created` event is published by `src/server/services/comment-service.ts`. Four source files register handlers for it:

- **`src/server/services/activity-service.ts`** (`registerActivityListeners`, ~line 198) records an activity-log row.
- **`src/server/services/search-service.ts`** (`registerSearchListeners`, ~line 150) re-indexes the comment for search.
- **`src/server/services/notification-service.ts`** (~line 203, module init) notifies the issue's watchers and mentioned users.
- **`src/server/services/webhook-service.ts`** (`registerWebhookListeners`, ~line 120) enqueues a webhook delivery for the org.

These are wired together by `src/server/services/event-registry.ts`, which calls the register functions at startup. I excluded the publisher, the event-type declarations and label maps (`src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/webhook.ts`, `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`), and the tests.

ANSWER: src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts
